svg.title: Flattened baseline recovery has a ten-probe bound
svg.desc: A passed stock reference supplies a loaded flattened target. Failed flattened candidates retreat at the same voltage, preserving tail geometry and checking unsafe bands before every probe.

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Stock reference passed under this tier's settings

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Build the loaded flattened target
Keep the stock measurement as reference

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Read the current blacklist
Jump below any blocked clock band
Keep the same voltage and tail policy

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No passing flattened baseline
First baseline: report failure
Later adaptive tier: skip that tier

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Retarget ceiling; apply and read back
Q2RTX-only baseline probe
Count this attempt: at most 10

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Keep this exact plan and metrics
Write the passing baseline checkpoint

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fewer than 10 probes
and another positive clock?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Lower the requested clock by 15 MHz

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Stop further probing; preserve earlier results
